From the kitchen

Photos from the café’s own Google listing.

A yard on Evanthias Pieridou

Edem's yard is a small breakfast and brunch place on Evanthias Pieridou street in Larnaca, a few streets from the seafront. Inside, white bistro chairs on a black and white checkered floor and a chandelier; outside, tables in the yard. The menu lies on every table: Eggs Benedict, bagels and sandwiches, French toast brioche and pancakes with lotus, Snickers or a topping of your choice. On Google, pancakes, eggs Benedict and bagels are what guests mention most, with 1,728 reviews and 4.7 stars.

Open Tuesday to Friday from eight in the morning until three, Saturday and Sunday from a quarter past nine until five, Monday closed. Guests write that there are no reservations and that the yard fills up at the weekend, so come early. Eat in, take away or delivery.

What guests say

Two of 1,728 Google reviews, 4.7 stars on average.

“Edem’s Yard is a lovely brunch spot in Larnaca. The brunch options are great and their desserts are amazing! The lotus pancakes were especially delicious and definitely a must try. The place has a nice, relaxed vibe that makes it perfect for a chill brunch. Really enjoyed the experience and would happily go back again.”
Rose · Google review
“If you find yourself in Larnaca, Edem’s Yard is an absolute must-visit. From the moment you walk in, you’re hit with an incredible aesthetic think bold turquoise walls, ornate gold frames, and a tropical-meets-vintage vibe that makes every corner feel like a curated art gallery. The atmosphere is vibrant, cozy, and effortlessly cool.”
Ian Appétit · Google review
